entities.summary: Sally Anne Bowman was an English hairdresser and model who was murdered in the early hours of 25 September 2005 in Croydon, London. 18 year-old Bowman had been robbed, raped and repeatedly stabbed. Mark Dixie, who had a history of robbery and sexual offences, was convicted of the murder and sentenced to life imprisonment with a recommended minimum of 34 years.
